title: Smoky
summary: Smoke from wood, chipotle, paprika, or char — a little goes far; build in layers.
origins: Taste profiles describe how we experience balance on the plate — smoky is a pattern chefs recognize and home cooks can learn.
history: Flavor pillars: smoke, salt, umami. Building depth means layering these elements rather than one heavy note.
teaching: Bright acid and fresh herbs keep smoke from tasting one-note.
